title: Freaky Serif Font
description: A bit of an old school take on the default font
body:
# A resourecepack that changes the default minecraft font to look more old school

> I had a vision to make a minecraft font with serifs because the aesthetic is based

> changed characters are
> - all the standard latin letters capital and little
> - numbers
> - some punctuation
> - most special letters from unicode **latin-1 supplement** and **latin extended-a**
> - the letters necessary to write Hanyu Pinyin _not counting the u's with double diacritics because minecraft doesn't like them_
